column1: # These sentences are the whole point of this file: they are authored *outside*

column2: The SH8601 is the display driver IC fitted to this board.
This board uses SH8601 silicon behind the QSPI bus.
The panel controller is manufactured by Sitronix as the SH8601.
The display has no backlight at all, so brightness is fixed.
The screen is self-lit, so there is no dimming control.
Click the dial to open the zone picker.
Push the dial in to confirm the selection.
The rotary shaft switch selects the highlighted zone.
The screen is an active-matrix organic LED panel.
The SoC is an ESP32S3 WROOM 1 module with 8 MB PSRAM.
The main chip is an ESP32-S3 WROOM1 N16R8.
The touch controller is the CST816S part.
The backlight starts at fifty percent brightness.
